title: Fallout
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#862, 2026-11-01), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal, rated 2 of 5 after 1 minutes: the opening logo plays at 120 fps and then slows to a crawl, the same with every graphics mode and all four of its launch options, the GOG copy. Not verified by the maintainer. udance4ever again in a comment on highball-db#862 (2026-11-03), in a Wine 11 environment on engine x64-crossover26.3-r28: on DXVK the logo still slows down. On D3DMetal and DXMT it slows down too and the window doesn't come up at the right size, and on WineD3D the game hangs, where on the Wine 10 engine it ran. The run was meant to try athei's x87sidecar, but the log has no sidecar attach line, so the sidecar wasn't active.
notes: Doesn't play in one report on an M1. The opening logo starts at 120 fps and then slows to a crawl, with every graphics mode on the Wine 10 engine and on the Wine 11 engine (r28), where WineD3D hangs too. It's a 32-bit game.

knownIssues.symptom: Slows to a crawl a moment into the opening logo, with every graphics mode (M1, Wine 10 r28 and Wine 11 r28)
